quotes.text: 7–9 On the first Rampage DR, the Elephant heads in the direction directly away from the unit that caused the rampage. A 7-9 on any subsequent die roll means the elephant’s mahout has been successful in stopping the rampage by driving a wedge into the beast’s brain; the Elephant unit is eliminated. If it is a Leader Elephant, the unit is, instead, immediately rallied with Cohesion Hits equal to its TQ minus 2.

Rampaging elephants have no ZOC, do not trigger Reaction Fire of any kind, and they may not be rallied. Each Rampage is undertaken until its conclusion, so there may never be more than one rampaging Elephant unit at any one time.
